trap.label: conector + oração
trap.wrong: Although of the rain, we went out.
trap.right: Although it rained, we went out.
trap.why: Português “apesar da chuva”. Although pede sujeito + verbo; despite pede substantivo ou -ing.

opts: Although he was tired, he worked.
Although he was tired but he worked.

fix.wrong: Although he was tired, but he worked.
fix.right: Although he was tired, he worked.

fix.wrong: Despite of the rain, we went.

rewrite.prompt: Use although: “He failed. He kept trying.”
rewrite.answer: Although he failed, he kept trying.

rewrite.prompt: Use despite: “It rained. We went out.” (the rain)
rewrite.answer: Despite the rain, we went out.

rewrite.prompt: Use even though: “She was ill. She worked.”
rewrite.answer: Even though she was ill, she worked.
